title: MOZAIC: An Audio-Video Deepfake Benchmark for Telling What Is Fake
description:
arXiv:2611.31301v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Audio-video (AV) deepfakes can fake the face, the voice, or both. Most benchmarks only ask whether a clip is real or fake, so they cannot show whether a detector relies on the picture, the voice, or encoding traces. We present MOZAIC, a paired benchmark with a 4-way label in which every source clip is released in all four combinations of real or fake video and real or fake audio so each modality contribution can be measured directly.
